notes.title: What a third day in a row of updates - I did my best -
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now see the VHS without having to shine a light on it!
[*] Added instructions for turning pages in the notebook!
[*] I changed the content of video 4.
[*] Some of the background music was too loud, but I reduced the volume of it.
[*] It is no longer possible to cross over the roof of the main building corridor (because I noticed that it was jammed without the round key)
[/list]

notes.title: Update _ some hints added
notes.content:
Thank you for reading. 
I added some hints, which include a hint of airplane object. 
Changed manual of running.
Changed the text of seeing brightness. 
Added some 3D models in the map.
